status_summary: On 2025-07-14 DOL announced, effective immediately, changes to the OSHA Field Operations Manual penalty section, issued as the Chapter 6 update to directive CPL 02-00-164: the 70 percent size reduction now covers employers with 1 to 25 employees, a 15 percent quick-fix reduction applies to permanently and substantially corrected eligible violations, and a 20 percent history reduction applies to employers never inspected or with no serious, willful or failure-to-abate violation in the prior five years. These are percentage reductions applied in series, and Area Directors may withhold the size and history reductions; they are not the exemption from fines the text asks for. No statutory exemption was found.
